It contained the {{Color|ContentCreator|Jordan}} [[Brawler]] skin, multiple balance changes and various bugfixes. This update encompassed three versions, the main v1.49.0 (released 15 January 2025) and two minor versions, the v1.49.1 (released 16 January 2025) and v1.49.2 (released 16 January 2025). ==Additions==
